more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; chewing gum; decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4; dried fruit and vegetables.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.side_effects:
Maximum-permitted-use estimates were below the limit.
The limit used animal subchronic evidence; longer-term and reproductive studies were unavailable.
more_info.overview: Hydrogenated poly-1-decene is a mixture of hydrogenated decene oligomers, specified as a synthetic hydrocarbon preparation. It forms a surface coating that gives the food a shiny appearance or provides a protective finish. The specification describes it as effectively insoluble in water. EU permissions include dried fruit and vegetables, other confectionery including breath freshening micro-sweets, chewing gum.
